decision: Drop exact duplicate rows and keep the first occurrence.
reason: Repeated export rows represent the same patient registration without new information.

issue: gender spellings that are not a code
decision: Strip, lowercase, and map valid spellings to F, M, or X; set unknown or blank values to missing.
reason: Standardizes free-text gender entries into the three contract categories while leaving unrecorded values missing.

decision: Uppercase site_code and remove all spaces and hyphens.
reason: Ensures consistent formatting so patient records match the normalized keys in the site directory.

decision: Replace 9999 with missing (NA) and cast to nullable Int64.
reason: 9999 is a sentinel code for unrecorded birth year rather than a real birth year.

issue: weight column named wt_kg in visits_south.csv
decision: Rename wt_kg to weight_kg before stacking with visits_north.csv.
reason: Aligns column names across both clinic exports so weights stack into a single unified column.

issue: sbp sentinel 999 and readings outside 70 through 250
decision: Convert values outside 70-250 mmHg, including sentinel 999, to missing (NA) in Int64.
reason: Removes unmeasured sentinel codes and physiologically implausible recording errors while keeping the visit row.

issue: impossible and loosely written visit dates
decision: Parse only exact YYYY-MM-DD calendar dates and convert invalid strings to NaT.
reason: Enforces strict date formatting and prevents non-existent calendar dates from corrupting longitudinal timelines.

decision: Sort by visit_time and keep the last record for each (patient_id, visit) pair.
reason: Same-visit repeats represent clinical rechecks where the later measurement is the final reading.

decision: Filter sites to keep only rows where record_status is current.
reason: Retains the active clinic metadata per site_code and removes outdated retired versions before joining.
